questions.q: What does the book call its writer, the son of David, king in Jerusalem?
questions.evidence: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem

questions.q: Where does the Preacher say there is nothing new?
questions.evidence: and that which has been done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun

questions.q: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under what?
questions.evidence: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven

questions.q: What does the Preacher say are better than one?
questions.evidence: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor

questions.q: What does the Preacher keep calling everything?
questions.evidence: Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher

questions.q: "Remember also your Creator in the days of your" what?
questions.evidence: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them”

questions.q: What does the Preacher conclude is the whole duty of man?
options: Fear God and keep his commandments
Build a house and plant a vineyard
questions.evidence: Fear God, and keep his commandments
